awa-struggle.label: Struggling with the GRE essay (Analytical Writing, AWA): a low essay score, or no one to grade my practice essays

consultant-or-sop-worth-it.label: Is a study-abroad consultant or SOP writing service worth paying for, and which one can I trust?

gre-fees-add-up.label: The GRE itself costs a lot: the exam fee, retakes and score reports

gre-worth-taking.label: Is the GRE even worth taking, or a waste of money, now that many programs do not require it?

mock-vs-real-score.label: What will I score on the real GRE? Are my mock scores (PowerPrep, Kaplan, GregMat) accurate?

no-time-to-prepare.label: Not enough time to prepare: working full time, or the exam is only weeks away

prep-too-expensive.label: I cannot afford a prep course or coaching; what is the cheapest way to study?

quant-struggle.label: Struggling with GRE quant: hard for a non-maths background, or cannot get quant to 165-170

refund-after-cancelling.label: I cancelled or rescheduled my GRE and still have not got my refund

registration-or-payment-trouble.label: I can't register or pay for the GRE: my card or payment fails, or my registration name or ID does not match my passport

retake-or-not.label: Should I retake the GRE? Will it help, how often can I, what does it cost, how do schools see it?

score-enough-for-target.label: Is my score good enough for my target programs, or will a low score ruin my application?

score-not-improving.label: My GRE score is not improving: stuck at a particular score, going down, or short of my target

score-reporting-mistakes.label: I cancelled or did not report my score by mistake, or want to hide a bad score: can I undo it?

scores-held-or-cancelled.label: At-home test trouble: scores unavailable, on hold or cancelled by ETS

scores-late-for-deadline.label: My scores have not reached my schools, or will not arrive before the application deadline

silly-mistakes.label: Losing marks to stupid, careless mistakes

test-anxiety-or-burnout.label: GRE stress: anxiety, panic or burnout that stops me studying or ruins the test

test-day-worse-than-practice.label: I scored lower on the real test than on my practice tests (it felt harder, I crumbled under pressure)

verbal-struggle.label: Struggling with GRE verbal and vocabulary, especially as a non-native English speaker

which-prep-worth-paying-for.label: Is this coaching or course worth the money, or is self-study enough?
